set.pl: Knoll cluster in the former swamp W of Leoni village, Leoni Twp, Jackson Co (lidar; 1911 plat: Chappell land N of the village, sec 35; 1933 account: King/Chappel/Bates swamp on the Michigan Central)
pinev: 1911 Ogle Jackson Co atlas, Leoni plate pp. 76-77 (archive.org 3927885.0001.001.umich.edu leaf 0078): 'S. E. Chappelle 214' just N of Leoni village and E of the Michigan Central, wet ground along the track; 'S. E. Chappell 60' at the 25/36 corner; directory Vern Chappell sec 35 Leoni; no King or Bates in 1911; no 'Bogus Island' or knoll label.

MI state lidar (PC read): raised knoll cluster in the marsh W of the village at ~42.2618,-84.2945; a second single knob to the SE; neither labelled; cave filled before 1933. Treasure rates the placement C-plus.
set.t: No hoard claimed: record only. Look-only: private marsh.
